basic_profile.bio: Avid Skyrim enthusiast and VR modder from the Pacific Northwest. I've been dabbling in game modding since high school, starting with simple texture packs and gradually moving onto more complex mechanics. When I'm not engrossed in creating the ultimate Skyrim VR experience, you can find me playing double bass in a local jazz band. I work as a software developer during the day, and I'm currently single. My typical online hours are late evenings after work, when I can unwind and dive into my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in software development, with a degree in Computer Science. My passion for gaming led me to self-teach modding techniques, particularly for VR platforms. I frequently engage with communities to stay updated on the latest advancements and best practices.
